title: campanula gracilis var. littoralis
intro: Campanula gracilis var. littoralis, commonly known as alpine bellflower, is a plant species that belongs to the Campanulaceae family. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems and gastrointestinal disorders, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of alpine bellflower include soothing coughs, reducing fever, and promoting digestion, making it a valuable remedy in herbal medicine. The bioactive constituents of alpine bellflower include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
